fal_landlord.text: Welcome to the Globe, the best pub in the best town in the South Atlantic, which is a short list. Quiz night is Thursday, and the Navy always loses.

fal_regular.text: In the 1850s Stanley was the place to refit before Cape Horn, and the pubs were full of sailors who had just been round it. I'm told some had a faraway look. I'm told the same of anyone who has just been to Camp.
If you want to be an islander, learn to say 'smoko' and learn to stand up for the weather. Everything else comes with time.
